## Classes

### network

Used to configure networking for linux and freebsd hosts

#### Examples

##### 

```puppet
class { 'network':
  interfaces           => {
    'eth0'             => {
      'addr4'          => '192.0.2.42',
      'addr6'          => '2001:db8::42',
      'gw4'            => '192.0.2.1',
      'gw6'            => '2001:db8::1',
      'nameservers'    => ['8.8.8.8'],
      'nameservers6'   => ['2001:4860:4860::8888'],
    },
  },
  dummy4                => {
    'dns'               => '192.0.2.53',
    'http'              => ['192.0.2.80', 192.0.2.443'],
  },
  dummy6                => {
    'dns'               => '192.0.2.53',
    'http'              => ['192.0.2.80', 192.0.2.443'],
  },
  sysctl                 => {
    'net.core.somaxconn' => { 'value' =>'1024' },
  },
  additional_hosts       => {
    'foobar.example.com' => {
      'ip'               => '192.0.2.254',
      'host_aliases'     => ['foobar'],
    },
  },
  prefer_ipv4            => false,
  purge_hosts            => false,
}
```

#### Parameters

The following parameters are available in the `network` class.

##### `interfaces`

Data type: `Hash[String[1],Network::Interface]`

a hash of interfaces to create

Default value: {}

##### `dummy4`

Data type: `Optional[Hash[String[1], Network::Dummy4]]`

a hash of ipv4 dummy interfaces to create

Default value: {}

##### `dummy6`

Data type: `Optional[Hash[String[1], Network::Dummy6]]`

a hash of ipv6 dummy interfaces to create

Default value: {}

##### `sysctl`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

a hash of sysctl types to pass to thias/sysctl

Default value: {}

##### `additional_hosts`

Data type: `Optional[Hash]`

a hash of additional `host` type entries to create

Default value: {}

##### `prefer_ipv4`

Data type: `Boolean`

if true then the system will prefer IPv4 connections over IPv6

Default value: `true`

##### `purge_hosts`

Data type: `Boolean`

if true purge any `host` entries not managed by puppet

Default value: `true`

##### `primary`

Data type: `Optional[String]`



Default value: `undef`
